name_en: Aburafu don — deep-fried wheat gluten rice bowl
summary_ja: 棒状にして揚げた油麩を、かつ丼のように甘辛い出汁で煮て卵でとじ、ご飯にのせた登米市の丼。豆腐店が保存の利く麩を考案したのが始まりで、地元旅館の女将が丼に仕立てたと伝わる。
summary_en: Deep-fried wheat gluten, shaped into a log, is simmered in a sweet-savory broth and set with egg over rice, katsudon-style — a Tome City bowl said to trace to a tofu shop's shelf-stable gluten product, later turned into a bowl dish by a local innkeeper.
source_title: 油麩丼 宮城県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
